import pandas as pd

messy = pd.read_csv("orders_messy.csv")

missing_by_col = messy.isna().sum()
print(missing_by_col)

messy["channel"] = messy["channel"].fillna("unknown")
messy["quantity"] = messy["quantity"].astype("Int64")

avg_quantity = round(float(messy["quantity"].mean()), 2)
